statement: Grok Build's pinned ToolBridge owns a finalized tool registry, exposes model-facing definitions, supports built-in and MCP-backed registrations, and routes tool calls through the registry's typed dispatch boundary.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build ToolBridge 持有已 finalise 的 tool registry，提供面向模型的定义，支持 built-in 与 MCP-backed 注册，并通过 registry 的 typed dispatch boundary 路由工具调用。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned ToolBridge owns a finalized registry, exposes model-facing definitions, supports built-in and MCP-backed registrations, and routes calls through typed registry dispatch.

evidence.title: Grok Build ToolBridge
evidence.locator: ToolBridge registry construction, definitions, and call
